scene: Atop the lighthouse balcony, three strange rides wait to depart.
picture: Side view of the outdoor lighthouse balcony deck. Far left, a striped hot-air balloon basket sways beside a railing gate. Left of centre, the boy in orange vest and kite stands facing right. Centre, a metal chairlift seat hangs from an overhead cable. Far right, an enclosed red sleigh tram sits on rail tracks.
shown: a tethered striped hot-air balloon floating at the far left
an empty metal chairlift seat hanging on a cable in the centre
a frosted red sleigh tram resting on icy tracks at the far right
